_comment: First Steps: the guided first month (systems/firstSteps.js). Each step's `check` names a reader in code that looks at real player/world state; `go` names what the tracker card's button opens (ui/firstStepsCard.js): an action-menu action type (`action`) or a panel (`panel`). Rewards are paid once, on completion: gold (recorded on the ledger as `firstSteps`), renown; the final reward adds House Prestige.

steps.title: See a day through
steps.why: Everything in the realms moves by the day: wages are paid, food is eaten, wounds heal and news travels when the day ends.
steps.how: Press ⌛ End Turn at the bottom right of the screen.

steps.title: Scout the land
steps.why: The map is dark until you walk it. Every hex you uncover shows roads, towns, resources and danger.
steps.how: Click a hex next to you on the map to walk there. Uncover two new hexes to finish ‘A New Beginning’ (Quests tab).

steps.title: Earn an honest coin
steps.why: Day work is the surest income when you own nothing yet, and every job trains a skill.
steps.how: In a town or village: click your own hex → ⚔ Open Actions → 🔨 Look for Work, and take a job.

steps.title: Visit the market
steps.why: You must eat: bread and grain keep your hunger off. Prices differ from town to town, and buying cheap to sell dear is how merchants grow rich.
steps.how: In a town: Open Actions → ⚖️ Trade Goods, then buy or sell anything (start with some food).

steps.title: Talk to the townsfolk
steps.why: Friends lend help, carry news, find you work and may one day marry into your House.
steps.how: In a town: Open Actions → 👥 Meet People → 💬 Talk to anyone, and chat with them.

steps.title: Take on a task
steps.why: Bounties and quests pay far better than day work and build your name.
steps.how: In a town: Open Actions → 📋 Notice Board, and accept a bounty — or accept a quest from the Quests tab.

steps.title: Sleep under a roof
steps.why: A night on the road leaves you tired, dirty and open to sickness. An inn's bed and breakfast restore you.
steps.how: In a town: Open Actions → 🛏️ Find Lodgings (or Lodge at …), book a room, then end the day.

steps.title: Give your House an Ambition
steps.why: Your House outlives you. An Ambition is its long goal: its milestones earn Prestige, which your heirs inherit.
steps.how: Top bar → 🗝️ Counsel → beside ‘Your House has no Ambition’ press House, then choose one.

steps.title: Travel to a second town
steps.why: No town has everything. Other markets pay more for your goods, and other lords may favour you.
steps.how: Click a distant town on the map to set out (it may take more than one day), then enter it.

_dawnSteps: A start at the Dawn of Man (world/dawn.js): no towns, markets or inns yet, so the guidance follows the clan instead.

dawnSteps.title: See a day through
dawnSteps.why: The world moves by the day: your clan eats, wanders and grows when the day ends.
dawnSteps.how: Press ⌛ End Turn at the bottom right of the screen.

dawnSteps.title: Sit at your clan's fire
dawnSteps.why: Your family and your people walk with you: their tents go up wherever the clan stops.
dawnSteps.how: Stand with your clan: click your own hex → ⚔ Open Actions → 🧭 Explore Interior, and walk to the campfire.

dawnSteps.title: Scout the land
dawnSteps.why: Good ground is near fresh water: a river, a lake, the shore. Fertile plains feed more mouths than forest or hills.
dawnSteps.how: Click a hex next to you on the map to walk there; your clan follows. Uncover two new hexes to finish ‘A New Beginning’.

dawnSteps.title: Make camp for good
dawnSteps.why: A clan that stays becomes a village: it grows, trades, sends out new clans — and in time a village with others about it becomes a chiefdom.
dawnSteps.how: Lead your clan to good ground (by a river is best), then Open Actions → 🔥 Make camp for good.

dawnSteps.title: Give your House an Ambition
dawnSteps.why: Your House outlives you. An Ambition is its long goal: its milestones earn Prestige, which your heirs inherit.
dawnSteps.how: Top bar → 🗝️ Counsel → beside ‘Your House has no Ambition’ press House, then choose one.

dawnSteps.title: Visit another village
dawnSteps.why: Other clans have settled too. Their people trade what yours lack, and one day one of you will rule the others.
dawnSteps.how: Enter your own village, then walk to another (the trodden paths lead there) and enter it.

final.title: First Steps taken
final.text: You have found your feet. From here, the Steward's 🗝️ Counsel tab names what matters most each day.
